body:
## Welcome to Swight UHC Overlay!

**Swight UHC Overlay** is a clean and performance-friendly Minecraft resource pack overlay specifically designed to enhance your **UHC (Ultra Hardcore)** and PvP gameplay. It tweaks crucial elements to give you the ultimate competitive edge without ruining the vanilla feel of the game.

### ⚔️ Key Features
* **Low Fire:** Keeps your screen clear when you are burning so you can actually see your targets.
* **Clear Inventory:** Sleek UI container designs for faster looting and crafting.
* **Short Swords:** Shorter weapon models to maximize your field of view during intense melee fights.

### 🚀 How to Use
Since this is an **overlay**, simply place it at the very top of your Resource Packs list in Minecraft. It works perfectly alongside your favorite default or custom PvP texture packs!
